parts.name: Root
parts.description: The disclosure container. It holds the open state and gives the context to the trigger and to the panel.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state. By default it goes in the two directions: use `bind:open`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state at the start, for when you give no `open`.

props.name: controlledOpen
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the open state. The component stops to write back to `open`,
and it reports only through `onOpenChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the parent
does not send the new value down. The default is off, because `bind:open` is the usual case and
it needs the write-back.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the user opens or closes the panel.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the trigger. It cannot open or close the panel.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger part and the panel part.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the root element. The component makes the ids of the trigger and of the panel from it. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable object with the state of the collapsible (`isOpen` and `isDisabled`) and with the `setOpen` and `toggle` functions.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel is open.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The button. It shows and hides the panel, with native button activation.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the collapsible is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel is open.

parts.name: Panel
parts.description: The content that the trigger shows and hides. While it is closed, it is hidden and inert.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keep the closed panel in the DOM, and hidden. Without it, the panel leaves the DOM after the
exit animation.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-closed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel is closed (with `forceMount` or during the exit transition).

dataAttributes.name: data-collapsible-panel-content
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the inner content element for the height measurement.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present for one frame when the panel starts to close, for the exit transition.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-starting-style
dataAttributes.description: Present for one frame when the panel starts to open, for the enter transition.
